beats.voice: Your day has too many open tabs.
beats.visual: One line of kinetic type; three cropped browser cards gather.
beats.background: Openverse city-at-dusk photo, darkened; image subject on right, text on left.
beats.sound: One soft recorded tab/click; voice starts immediately.

beats.voice: And every little task takes another detour.
beats.visual: Cards briefly spread; Confused Rex glances between them.
beats.background: Same photo, then a clean charcoal field.
beats.sound: One short paper/air move; leave the rest quiet.

beats.visual: Confused logo settles beside the name.
beats.background: Charcoal; restrained red halo behind the mark.
beats.sound: Short recorded riser arriving into one soft impact.

beats.voice: Your voice operator, ready to get things moving.
beats.visual: Match-cut logo into the actual dashboard mascot.
beats.background: Paper-white outer field; real dark dashboard inside.
beats.sound: Music establishes its beat; no extra impact.

beats.voice: Rex, desk lamps dhoondo. Links save karo.
beats.visual: Real microphone interaction and Hinglish transcript. English subtitle: Find desk lamps. Save the links.
beats.background: Product UI; isolate the transcript and mic.
beats.sound: User voice replaces narration here; duck music and SFX.

beats.voice: On it. I’ll find a few options.
beats.visual: Rex listening → thinking; short acknowledgement in captions.
beats.background: Same UI, no decorative background motion.
beats.sound: Rex voice; one very quiet UI confirmation if needed.

beats.voice: It searches the web for your request.
beats.visual: Real search action and readable source links.
beats.sound: Soft recorded keyboard run only where actual typing appears.

beats.voice: Brings useful links into one place.
beats.visual: Two or three genuine source results come into focus.
beats.background: Same UI; source names remain visible.
beats.sound: One family of light card settles, not one hit per result.

beats.voice: And saves the shortlist in Files.
beats.visual: Files view opens a saved Desk lamp shortlist note.
beats.background: Paper field; close crop on the real saved note.
beats.sound: Single short save sound on the visible save/completion event.

beats.visual: Second user request appears in the conversation. Arjun is a synthetic demo persona.
beats.sound: User voice; no typing noise under spoken request.

beats.voice: Rex prepares the message for your review.
beats.visual: Show the proposed recipient, subject and shortlist links.
beats.background: Real action preview, isolated from demo metric cards.
beats.sound: A quiet UI reveal only; no sent notification.

beats.voice: You check the details before it sends.
beats.visual: Hold the actual Approve / Deny controls, readable.
beats.sound: Music thins; allow a deliberate pause.

beats.visual: Show the decision control. A send/result appears only if actually captured in an authorized test.
beats.background: Same UI; avoid a fabricated success toast.
beats.sound: Click only if pressed in the captured footage; chime only on a genuine confirmation.

beats.voice: It can remember the details you choose.
beats.visual: Memory view with a deliberately saved synthetic desk-setup preference.
beats.background: Paper field, one genuine memory item.

beats.voice: Your inbox. Your calendar. Your workspace.
beats.visual: Three simple real connection cards; no separate feature claims beyond visible integrations.
beats.background: Clean paper field; no made-up live counters.
beats.sound: Two gentle transition gestures from the same family.

beats.voice: Speak naturally. Even when you mix languages.
beats.visual: Hinglish transcript remains the proof; English subtitles persist.
beats.background: Brief Openverse India photo crop behind a large transcript card.
beats.sound: Music carries this beat; skip street noise under the words.

beats.visual: Small factual caption: Gnani Prisma STT + Timbre TTS.
beats.background: Return to charcoal; flat red/white typography.

beats.visual: Confused logo and name; one brief Excited eye reaction, returning to Confused.
beats.sound: One soft recorded logo settle; music begins to resolve.

beats.visual: Confused logo, Try Rex. Final verified demo/repo URL to be supplied.
beats.background: Same dark end card, held long enough to read.
beats.sound: Music resolves; no wake-word implication and no extra UI clicks.
